items.en_title: Itaporã do Tocantins (TO) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #005
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itaporã do Tocantins (TO) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 102,256.65; proposals close Dec 2 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
